name: dnr
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && curl -fsSL https://cli.kiro.dev/install | bash
postCreateCommand: sudo corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && (pnpm -C packages/cli link --global || echo 'dnr is not linkable yet: packages/cli has no bin until Phase 2')
postAttachCommand: echo 'Next: dnr doctor, then scripts/demo/make-demo-checkout.sh and kiro-cli login (README#testing)'
